Dear Litware Ltd,

We have processed your refund of **310** for the reshipping fee due to the incorrect hardware shipment. The correct shipping site, **Rotterdam DC-FY88**, has been confirmed in our records.

If you need to track the new shipment or require further assistance, please reply to this email or contact our support team.

Thank you for your patience.

Best regards,
IT Operations Team
